newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives to set up millenium tech. fund.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives to set up millenium tech. fund.

text.p: Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine on Thursday proposed that the 300 million stg of National Lottery proceeds spent every year on millennium projects be channeled in three years' time into a new information and communication technology fund.

Heseltine told the Conservative party annual conference that the fund would pay for a new range of computers in schools, giving pupils full access to information and enabling carers and volunteers to provide more effective service.
The decision would not affect the guarantees that the government has given to the Millennium Commission in respect of a festival to mark the dawn of the 21st century, Heseltine said.
